cells.title: CENTER / PERIPHERY: superpose_concentric
cells.desc: A and B share a centre

cells.title: NEAR / FAR: superpose_displaced
cells.desc: A and B set apart, not touching

cells.title: CONTACT: cross
cells.desc: A and B cut each other

cells.title: LINK: concatenate
cells.desc: A and B joined end to end

cells.title: BALANCE: reflect_pair
cells.desc: A placed against its own mirror

cells.title: UP / DOWN: no attested operator
cells.desc: needs a privileged vertical; see updown-is-meaningful

cells.title: FRONT / BACK: no attested operator
cells.desc: needs a distinguished direction along the figure

cells.title: PATH: no attested operator
cells.desc: needs source and goal told apart, i.e. a direction

cells.title: PART / WHOLE: no attested operator
cells.desc: mereological, not positional — a different gap
